title: The Grunion Run, xix
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Nineteenth year. The pup's first run. He goes into the surf like the first dog did and comes out with a fish in his mouth, which the first dog never managed.

panels.composition: The beach, lanterns, the run. GULLY, MARIA, the two kids. WOOD. BARNABY II hitting the surf at full scuttle.

image.prompt: a night beach festival with lanterns, a family at a coffee thermos, a thin man with a pad, a three-legged dog charging into a surf line full of silver fish, clean ink

panels.composition: The pup, a fish in his mouth, astonished at himself.

image.prompt: close-up of a wiry three-legged dog with a small silver fish in its mouth and an astonished expression, lantern light

panels.composition: Gully's girl, six, shrieking with joy. Wood drawing the pup, fast.

balloons.text: Sixteen years the other one tried.

image.prompt: a small girl shrieking with joy at a dog with a fish while a thin man sketches fast

panels.composition: Silent. The fish. The lanterns. The pup at the surf, fish surrendered, soaked, tripod-proud. Wood, pad closed, looking at him the way he looked at the first one.

image.prompt: silent wide night beach panel: a soaked three-legged dog standing proud at a surf line of silver fish under lanterns, a man with a closed pad watching, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: The pup catches one. The first dog never did.
